title: PGPainless: Unbounded Compressed Packet Descent in inline-detach and MessageInspector leads to Denial of Service (DoS)…
description: A vulnerability in the PGPainless library allows remote unauthenticated attackers to bypass the built-in maximum layer depth limit for compressed OpenPGP packets. By crafting messages with deeply nested compressed packet structures, attackers can cause unbounded recursive decompression leading to resource exhaustion, thread blocking, and potential application crashes due to out-of-memory conditions. This affects applications using the library's inline-detach and MessageInspector components for processing untrusted OpenPGP messages.
